## Read-Dropout QC
```{r summary-table-individual, echo=FALSE}

# Load and combine all data SAFELY
all_data <- read.csv("/Users/spencertoth/Desktop/Research/canine_skin_project/canine_skin_microbiome_R/ITS/02_input_files/csv_files/seqruns_final_summary_read_counts.csv")
sample_metadata_og <- read.delim("/Users/spencertoth/Desktop/Research/canine_skin_project/canine_skin_microbiome_R/metadata/CH-All_ITS_Metadata_20220124.tsv", header=TRUE)


all_data <- all_data %>% 
  rename(
    Sample      = sample,
    Individual = Individual,
    Total_Reads    = Raw_Sum,
    No_Ns = No_Ns_Sum,
    No_Primers = No_Primers_Sum,
    Trimmed_Reads  = Trimmed_Sum,
    denoised_forward = denoised_reads,
    No_Chimeras = chimeras_removed_reads,
    Canine_ID      = Dog_ID,
    Sample_Site    = Sample_Site,
    Category       = Collection_Cat,
    Surgery        = Surgery_Type
  ) 

dog_totals <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Individual) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Reads_Dog = sum(Total_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Removed_Ns_Dog = sum(No_Ns, na.rm = TRUE),
    Remove_Primers_Dog = sum(No_Primers, na.rm = TRUE),
    Filtered_Reads_Dog = sum(Trimmed_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Final_Reads_Dog = sum(No_Chimeras, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Total_Reads_Dog)

dog_totals$Individual <- factor(dog_totals$Individual, levels = dog_totals$Individual)

ggplot(dog_totals, aes(x = Individual)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Total_Reads_Dog), fill = "#1b9e77", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Removed_Ns_Dog), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Remove_Primers_Dog), fill = "yellow", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Filtered_Reads_Dog), fill = "#FF9900", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Final_Reads_Dog), fill = "#CC00CC", alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Individual",
    y = "Reads",
    title = "Total Reads and Final Reads per Individual",
    subtitle = "Ordered from lowest to highest total reads"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


all_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(
    sample_metadata_og %>% dplyr::select(Sample_Unique, Sample_Plate), 
    by = c("Sample" = "Sample_Unique")
  )
 

summary_by_run <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Sample_Plate) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Samples = n(),
    Tot_Raw      = sum(Total_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_Removed_Ns_Dog = sum(No_Ns, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_Remove_Primers_Dog = sum(No_Primers, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_Trimmed  = sum(Trimmed_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_F_Denois = sum(denoised_forward, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_NoChim   = sum(No_Chimeras, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    
    mean_Raw      = mean(Total_Reads, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    mean_Removed_Ns_Dog = mean(No_Ns, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    mean_Remove_Primers_Dog = mean(No_Primers, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    mean_Trimmed  = mean(Trimmed_Reads, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    mean_F_Denois = mean(denoised_forward, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    mean_NoChim   = mean(No_Chimeras, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    
    
    Ns_Read_Loss_Pct          = round((Tot_Raw - Tot_Removed_Ns_Dog) / Tot_Raw * 100, 1),
    Primers_Read_Loss_Pct          = round((Tot_Removed_Ns_Dog - Tot_Remove_Primers_Dog) / Tot_Removed_Ns_Dog * 100, 1),
    Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct          = round((Tot_Remove_Primers_Dog - Tot_Trimmed) / Tot_Remove_Primers_Dog * 100, 1),
    Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct = round((Tot_Trimmed - Tot_F_Denois) / Tot_Trimmed * 100, 1),
    Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct         = round((Tot_F_Denois - Tot_NoChim) / Tot_F_Denois * 100, 1),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample_Plate,
    N_Samples,
    mean_Raw,
    mean_Removed_Ns_Dog,
    mean_Remove_Primers_Dog,
    mean_Trimmed,
    mean_F_Denois,
    mean_NoChim,
    Ns_Read_Loss_Pct,
    Primers_Read_Loss_Pct,
    Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct,
    Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct,
    Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Plate)

 
 
kable(
  summary_by_run,
  caption = "Summary Statistics by Seq Run",
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c(
  "Seq. Run",
  "N Samples",
  "Raw",
  "Removed Ns",
  "Removed primers",
  "Filtered",
  "Denoised Fwd Average",
  "Chimeras-removed Average",
  "Ns removed Read Loss (%)",
  "Primers removed Read Loss (%)",
  "Trimmed Read Loss (%)",
  "Denoised Fwd Read Loss (%)",
  "Chimera Removal Read Loss (%)"
)
) %>%
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 2,
    "Read Average (k)" = 6,
    "Read % Loss at Each Processing Step" = 3
  )) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "lightgray") %>%
  column_spec(2, border_right = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(6, border_right = TRUE)
```

## % Read Loss Across Timepoints  
```{r individual-plots-read-loss, fig.height=15, fig.width=12, echo=FALSE}
cat_order <- c(
 "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct"
)

label_map <- c(
  "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Trimmed % Loss",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Fwd Denoised % Lost",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Chimeras % Lost"
)

summary_by_sample <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Samples = n(),
    
    # 1. Calculate the total sums for accurate percentage tracking
    Tot_Raw      = sum(Total_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_Trimmed  = sum(Trimmed_Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_F_Denois = sum(denoised_forward, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tot_NoChim   = sum(No_Chimeras, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # 2. Calculate the true means (Divided by 1000 for Thousands / 'k')
    Raw_Mean_k              = round((Tot_Raw / 1000)),
    Trimmed_Mean_k          = round((Tot_Trimmed / 1000)),
    Denoised_Forward_Mean_k = round((Tot_F_Denois / 1000)),
    No_Chimeras_Mean_k      = round((Tot_NoChim / 1000)),
    
    # 3. Calculate true run-level percentage losses from the sums
    Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct          = round((Tot_Raw - Tot_Trimmed) / Tot_Raw * 100, 1),
     Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct = round((Tot_Trimmed - Tot_F_Denois) / Tot_Trimmed * 100, 1),
    Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct         = round((Tot_F_Denois - Tot_NoChim) / Tot_F_Denois * 100, 1),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 4. Remove the temporary total columns used for calculations
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("Tot_"))  

 

plot_data <- summary_by_sample %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cat_order),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Read_Loss_Pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = cat_order)
  )

colors <- c(
  "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#1b9e77",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#FF9900",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#CC00CC"
)

 
summary_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_val = min(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0(
 #     "n=", n(), "\n",
      "Mean: ", round(mean_val, 1), "%\n",
  #    "Median: ", round(median_val, 1), "%\n",
      "Min: ", round(min_val, 1), "%\n",
      "Max: ", round(max_val, 1), "%"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(y = 35)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Category, y = Read_Loss_Pct, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_label(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(x = Category, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    label.size = 0.5,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_map) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Processing Step",
    y = "Read Loss (%)",
    title = "Read Loss by Processing Step Across Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## % Read Loss Across Timepoints per sample 
```{r individual-plots-read-loss, fig.height=15, fig.width=12, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

cat_order <- c(
 "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct"
)

label_map <- c(
  "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Trimmed % Loss",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Fwd Denoised % Lost",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct" = "Chimeras % Lost"
)

plot_data <- all_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cat_order),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Read_Loss_Pct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = cat_order),
    Canine_ID = factor(Individual, levels = unique(Individual))
  )

colors <- c(
  "Trimmed_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#1b9e77",
  "Forward_Denoised_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#FF9900",
  "Chimeras_Read_Loss_Pct" = "#CC00CC"
)


dog_plots <- plot_data %>%
  split(.$Canine_ID) %>%
  map(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = Category, y = Read_Loss_Pct, fill = Category)) +
        geom_col(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.8) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = label_map) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = c(0, 40),
          breaks = seq(0, 40, by = 10),
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
        ) +
        labs(
          title = as.character(unique(.x$Canine_ID)),
          x = "Processing Step",
          y = "Read Loss (%)"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 40)
        ))

wrap_plots(dog_plots, ncol = 5)


summary_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_val = median(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_val = min(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_val = max(Read_Loss_Pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0(
 #     "n=", n(), "\n",
      "Mean: ", round(mean_val, 1), "%\n",
  #    "Median: ", round(median_val, 1), "%\n",
      "Min: ", round(min_val, 1), "%\n",
      "Max: ", round(max_val, 1), "%"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(y = 35)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Category, y = Read_Loss_Pct, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_label(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(x = Category, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    label.size = 0.5,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_map) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 40),
    breaks = seq(0, 40, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Processing Step",
    y = "Read Loss (%)",
    title = "Read Loss by Processing Step Across Individuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
